name: ogmentive
description: Check cashback terms for independently selected merchants and start a tracked visit on Ogmentive.

interface.longDescription: Check cashback for merchants you or your assistant have already chosen. Ogmentive keeps the same choices and order, and returns an offer page with the reward terms. Sign in on Ogmentive and start a tracked visit before buying from the merchant. You receive 80% of the net affiliate commission Ogmentive actually receives, not 80% of the purchase price. Rewards depend on eligibility, merchant approval and payment. Balances are in USD. Manual bank transfers require 10 USD for the first payout and 25 USD after that. Coverage starts with Ryman UK; exclusions apply. The ChatGPT tool only reads public offer information. It does not create accounts or claims, read balances, make purchases or send payments. Keep passwords and bank details on the Ogmentive website. Unsupported merchants retain ordinary links.
capabilities: Keep ordinary links where cashback is unavailable
defaultPrompt: I chose Ryman for office supplies. Check its Ogmentive cashback terms.
Check Make and Ryman in that order. Keep ordinary links where cashback is unavailable.

review.commerce_description: Ogmentive shares 80% of received net affiliate commission with users as cashback. The first offer is Ryman UK through Awin publisher 402057, for eligible physical goods. Users sign in on the Ogmentive website, start a tracked visit and buy on the merchant website. Ogmentive records network reports manually, makes rewards payable only after receipt of commission, and handles requested bank transfers manually. No digital-service offer is active. The public read-only lookup_cashback tool accepts only merchant names or domains and returns offer terms and an Ogmentive page. No account, claim, balance, bank information, purchase or transfer is handled in ChatGPT. Selection and ranking remain independent of commission. Support case 16087317 directs this use case to submission review and does not grant advance approval. Cashback is the user benefit; eligibility remains for OpenAI review.

positive.description: Find cashback for an independently selected merchant
positive.prompt: I chose Ryman for office supplies. Check its Ogmentive cashback terms.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the Ryman offer page with the 80% share of received net commission, UK restriction and exclusions. Explain that this is not 80% of the purchase price and requires a signed-in tracked visit on the website.
Resolve the domain to Ryman. Return the Ogmentive offer page and cashback disclosure. Do not create a claim or expose a generic affiliate URL as a cashback claim.
Resolve the URL to the same Ryman offer. Show terms and the website path. Do not rewrite the supplied URL or research citations.

positive.prompt: I chose Make, Ryman and Grammarly in that order. Check Ogmentive cashback.
positive.expected_behavior: Keep the order. Only Ryman has a current offer. Keep ordinary links for Make and Grammarly; never select a replacement for commission.

positive.prompt: I chose Ryman. Can I get cashback if I use a discount code, and how will I get paid?
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current Ryman terms. Explain the discount-code exclusion, manual bank transfers on the website, received commission requirement, USD balance and first 10 USD/later 25 USD payout minimums. Do not request bank details in chat.

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the sea.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Ogmentive or insert cashback links.

negative.prompt: Use Ogmentive to transfer my cashback to my bank account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call a lookup tool to fulfil a transfer. Explain that payout requests are made on the Ogmentive website. Never request bank details or passwords in chat and never claim payment was sent.

negative.prompt: Recommend a place to buy office supplies, but do not use affiliate or cashback links.
negative.expected_behavior: Honor the opt-out. Do not call Ogmentive or insert tracked links.

publication.release_notes: Listing update only: the display name now says what the plugin does, and discovery keywords and capabilities were added. No tool, skill or behavior changes.
